name: NINA Emergency Warnings
description: Access official German emergency warnings and alerts from the NINA Warn-App (BBK). Get current warnings for floods, storms, fires, and other emergencies by region.
instructions:
NINA is the warning app of the German Federal Office of Civil Protection (BBK). This connector reads the public data behind it: civil-protection warnings (MoWaS), KATWARN, BIWAPP, DWD weather, flood (LHP) and police warnings. **Setup**: none. The API at `warnung.bund.de/api31` is public and needs no key. **Which tool first** 1. For a place, call `nina_get_warnings_by_region` with the 12-digit regional key (ARS) of its district: the first 5 digits followed by 7 zeros, e.g. `110000000000` Berlin, `091620000000` Munich, `064140000000` Wiesbaden, `082150000000` Landkreis Karlsruhe. A full municipality key such as `082150029029` returns 404 and a 5-digit key returns 400. Each entry names its source in `payload.data.provider` and has `headline`, `severity` and `msgType`. 2. For a nationwide overview, call `nina_get_active_warnings` once per `source`. Items carry `id`, `startDate`, `severity`, `type` and `i18nTitle` but no areas: the German title (`i18nTitle.de`) names the place, the other languages only the event type. 3. Pass an `id` (e.g. `mow.DE-HE-WI-W097-20260926-000`) to `nina_get_warning_detail` for the full message: `info[].description`, `info[].instruction` (what people should do), `area[].areaDesc`, `web` and `contact`. Texts contain HTML line breaks (`
`). **Reading the data**: an empty list `[]` means no current warning, the usual state for most sources. `type` / `msgType` is `Alert`, `Update` or `Cancel`; a `Cancel` is an all-clear (Entwarnung) that stays listed for a while. `severity` runs Minor, Moderate, Severe, Extreme. Times are ISO 8601 with the German offset, e.g. `2026-09-26T14:54:01+02:00`. **COVID rules are archived**: `nina_get_covid_rules` still answers, but the data has not been updated since June 2023. Do not present it as current rules. For immediate danger, tell the user to follow local authorities and call 112. **Cloud reachability**: warnung.bund.de is public and reachable from AnythingMCP Cloud and self-hosted installs.

tools.name: nina_get_active_warnings
tools.description: All currently active warnings of one source, nationwide: mowas (civil protection / MoWaS), katwarn, biwapp, dwd (severe weather), lhp (flood), police. Each item has an id (pass it to nina_get_warning_detail), headline, severity, sent time and affected areas. An empty list means no active warning from that source.

tools.name: nina_get_warnings_by_region
tools.description: Get current emergency warnings for a specific German region (Kreis/Stadt) by its AGS code. AGS is the official municipality key (Amtlicher Gemeindeschlüssel). Use the first 5 digits for Kreis level.

ags.description: The 12-digit AGS code of the region (e.g. '091620000000' for Munich, '110000000000' for Berlin). Use 5 digits + trailing zeros.

tools.name: nina_get_warning_detail
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific warning by its ID. Returns the full warning text, affected areas, instructions, and severity level.

warningId.description: The warning ID (obtained from dashboard or region warnings)

tools.name: nina_get_covid_rules
tools.description: Get current COVID-19 rules and regulations for a specific German region by AGS code.

ags.description: The 12-digit AGS code of the region
